extracted.name: Tirokafteri (Spicy Greek Feta Dip)
extracted.description: Tirokafteri is a spicy Greek feta dip made with roasted peppers and dried chile flakes for some heat. Make it as spicy or mild as you like.
ingredient_lines: 2 medium roasted red peppers, drained and chopped
0.25 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Combine feta cheese, red peppers, oil, vinegar, garlic, and pepper flakes in a food processor; puree in pulses until smooth. Avoid over-mixing as the heat from the food processor can make the tirokafteri runny.
Taste and adjust seasoning as desired, adding more red pepper flakes, vinegar, or garlic to taste.
Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with olives, if using. Serve immediately or refrigerate until serving.
